## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- MUAC planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 76.8M€2022, of which 31.3% relates to new major investments. MUAC planned 1 new major investment for RP4, which has not yet started.

- According to the reporting tables, MUAC underspent -1.6M€2022 (-17.9%) in costs related to investments in 2025. These amounts must be reimbursed to the airspace users through a reduction of future unit rate(s), unless the NSA decides after consultation with the users, that the ANSP must not reimburse a part of the difference according to article 28 of Regulation (EU) 2019/317.
